$comment: Closed theme set (FR-029). Source of truth: specs/003-pose-library/contracts/theme-taxonomy.md, signed off 2026-10-17 (14 themes). The emotion enum in pose.schema.json must list exactly these slugs; scripts/lib/theme-taxonomy.mjs checks it.

themes.label: Grief
themes.subhead: Poses that open the chest and ribs, where held breath tends to gather.

themes.label: Sadness
themes.subhead: Deep-tissue holds at the chest and inner groin, along the lung and liver lines.

themes.label: Fear
themes.subhead: Poses working the low back, kidneys, and inner legs — the body's deepest reserves.

themes.label: Frustration
themes.subhead: Side-body and outer-hip work, along the channels associated with stalled momentum.

themes.label: Vulnerability
themes.subhead: Front-body opening. Exposing the soft surfaces is the whole of the shape.

themes.label: Control
themes.subhead: Poses that ask the grip to soften rather than the range to increase.

themes.label: Courage
themes.subhead: Heart-opening shapes that widen the chest without bracing it.

themes.label: Surrender
themes.subhead: Supported, long-held shapes where the work is in stopping.

themes.label: Groundedness
themes.subhead: Weight low and wide, with the belly and legs taking the load.

themes.label: Anger
themes.subhead: Liver-channel work through the inner thigh and side waist.

themes.label: Openness
themes.subhead: Shapes that widen across the collarbones and the front of the shoulders.

themes.label: Letting go
themes.subhead: Passive spinal work along the back line, where holding is habitual.

themes.label: Trust
themes.subhead: Shapes that need support to enter, and settle once it is there.

themes.label: Integration
themes.subhead: Neutral, quieting shapes for the space after stronger work.
